tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
The full content of one search result (id from search: "question:<slug>", "test:mri", "specialist:neurology", "cover:<id>", "company:<slug>", "surgeon:<licence>"), with sources and the page URL.
התוכן המלא של תוצאת חיפוש אחת, עם המקורות והקישור לעמוד.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description:
The 7 Israeli insurers we read (alphabetical, no ranking) and every health cover of each, with its page URL and whether a checked plain-language summary exists.
חברות הביטוח והכיסויים של כל אחת, לפי סדר האלפבית.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description:
Everything the site answers: tests (keys for test_fast_routes), specialties (keys for specialist_routes), question pages, cover kinds, refund services (keys for refund_estimate), surgeon specialties and regions (for find_surgeon).
כל הנושאים: בדיקות, רופאים מומחים, שאלות, סוגי כיסוי.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
